description: This file defines a React functional component 'UserSearchModal' which provides a modal dialog for searching and selecting users by email or user ID, with role assignment features.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Fetches user data based on search text and selected field (email or user ID).

methods.name: debouncedSearch
methods.description: Debounced function to control the frequency of fetchUsers invocation.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, updates selected field, and triggers debounced search.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Updates form fields upon user selection from search results.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form and state, then triggers cancel callback.
